title: RhetorLint measurement labels
description: One reader's judgement of each mark, keyed by (item, ruleId, start, end) in UTF-16 code units into measurement/items/<item>.txt. actual must equal that slice. Labels are judgements, not ground truth, and they never feed conformance/.

label.description: TP: right construction, in use, doing the work the rule names. MENTION: right construction, quoted or exhibited as an example. DEBATABLE: right construction; whether it does that work is a judgement call. FPB: right surface construction, benign in context. FPW: wrong construction; the match is not the thing the rule describes.

candidate_only.description: true when HEAD core with rules.json did not produce this mark at labelling time; the row was labelled because a candidate engine did.
